chunks: Drinking water while standing during the day causes more perspiration and is stronger for the body.

key_terms.أَدَرُّ: more conducive to causing flow or perspiration

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about drinking water while standing during the day?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teaches an etiquette related to drinking water during the daytime. The hadith states that drinking while standing by day promotes perspiration and contributes to bodily strength.
